material.locator: Eurostat, Review and implementation of the degree of urbanisation — 2026 edition, §1.2 (printed p. 6) and §2.1 (printed p. 7).
material.description: §1.2 explains the need for harmonised definitions for international comparison. §2.1 describes the grid-based Degree of Urbanisation classification. Supports the use of a harmonised urban-to-rural statistical classification for comparisons; it does not establish a universal legal definition of settlement status.
